plan.goal: Seed HepG2 cells in logarithmic growth phase onto the culture area of a 400 µm wide, 20 mm long channel and determine cells to seed per channel.
plan.rationale: HepG2 log-phase seeding density is 50,000–100,000 cells/cm² (DSMZ ACC-180; ENCODE4 SOP). Channel floor culture area = width × length = 400 µm × 20 mm = 0.08 cm². Seeding count = density × area, giving 4,000–8,000 cells per channel. Assumes cells attach to the channel floor only.
caveats: Channel height (100 µm) is assumed for geometry completeness; it does not affect floor-area seeding count but matters for later perfusion/shear calculations.
Assumes cells attach to the channel floor only (width × length). If the device has a wider culture chamber or cells coat all walls, the area and seed count change.
Verify the actual channel footprint in your device before seeding.
Seed from a culture at ~50–70% confluence to ensure true logarithmic growth phase.
